start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:research-what-everyone-says." Research any subject, market, product or claim the way a hardcore researcher does: read what people out there say about it (social posts, threads, forums, reviews), what the companies in the field do, what the very best do, and every complaint and gap in all of them; lay the findings side by side to see what every source agrees on and where they contradict; rebuild the answer from first principles; and finish with the least obvious insights that would change the result most.
